Midday · Focus

Classic

The flagship blend

A carefully crafted fusion of five powerful essential oils — lemongrass, lemon, lavender, eucalyptus, and tea tree — enhanced with menthol crystals and capsicum extract.

This mild, minty formulation delivers a refreshing yet soothing sensation, making it a versatile wellness companion for everyday use. It helps ease muscle aches and pains, reduce discomfort from insect bites, and alleviate motion sickness.

Its calming aroma promotes restful sleep, and its comforting properties make it a go-to remedy at the first signs of fever or flu — balanced, effective, and gentle enough for any self-care routine.

"Conquer fatigue with Classic."
50 ml Lemongrass · Lemon · Lavender Eucalyptus · Tea Tree Menthol crystals
Morning · Clarity

Citrus Fusion

The bright, uplifting blend

A refreshing citrus-infused blend that combines the uplifting notes of orange and lemon essential oils with the calming benefits of chamomile, lavender, and eucalyptus.

Enriched with menthol and capsicum extract, this formulation delivers a gentle cooling warmth that soothes both body and mind — perfect for relieving tired, overworked muscles and easing headaches.

It also promotes deep relaxation and restful sleep. Its bright yet calming aroma creates a comforting experience, ideal for unwinding after a long day while supporting overall wellness.

"Conquer creative blocks with Citrus Fusion."
50 ml Orange · Lemon Chamomile · Lavender · Eucalyptus Menthol & Capsicum
Post-Workout · Recovery

Sports

Relief, recovery, revitalization

This expertly crafted aromatic oil blend is designed to support an active lifestyle by delivering a balance of relief, recovery, and revitalization.

Infused with peppermint, eucalyptus, and lemongrass essential oils, it helps ease muscle soreness, reduce inflammation, and relieve tension after intense physical activity.

Lavender and chamomile promote deep relaxation and restful sleep, key elements for effective recovery, while peppermint sharpens mental clarity and focus — making it an excellent companion even before workouts. Eucalyptus and peppermint also help open the airways, supporting easier breathing and improved endurance.

"Conquer muscle soreness with Sports."
Spray format Peppermint · Eucalyptus · Lemongrass Lavender · Chamomile
Anytime · On-the-go

Citrus Fusion Roller

Portability, distilled

A convenient, on-the-go version of the beloved Citrus Fusion blend, now enhanced with a higher menthol content for a stronger, more invigorating experience.

It carries the same refreshing infusion of orange and lemon essential oils, combined with calming chamomile, lavender, and eucalyptus, and enriched with menthol and capsicum extract.

Designed in a handy roller format, it allows for quick, mess-free application anytime, anywhere — making it perfect for travel and busy lifestyles. The cooling sensation eases headaches, soothes tired muscles, and promotes relaxation, while its bright citrus aroma uplifts the senses and supports restful sleep.

"Conquer stress-on-the-go with the Roller."
Roll-on format Orange · Lemon · Chamomile Higher menthol content
